duplicateCartCase.title: Verify that adding the same product to cart increments quantity instead of creating a new row

invalidProductCases.title: Verify that product detail page shows error when navigating with a non-existent product ID

Verify that product detail page shows error when product ID is a non-numeric string
Verify that product detail page handles an extremely large product ID gracefully

invalidQuantityCases.title: Verify that quantity field rejects zero value on the product detail page

Verify that quantity field rejects empty value on the product detail page

decimalQuantityCase.title: Verify that quantity field rejects decimal value on the product detail page

largeQuantityCase.title: Verify that system handles extremely large quantity value on the product detail page

unauthenticatedCase.title: Verify that Add to Cart is blocked for an unauthenticated user on the product detail page

boundaryProductCases.title: Verify that product detail page loads correctly with the smallest valid product ID (id=1)
Verify that product detail page loads correctly with the second smallest product ID (id=2)

validBoundaryQuantityCases.title: Verify that quantity field accepts the minimum valid value of 1 and Add to Cart succeeds
Verify that quantity field accepts the value 2 (one above minimum boundary)

baselineUpperBoundaryCase.title: Verify that quantity field accepts the system UI baseline upper boundary of 999
